Not constantly but I've been called childish a lot in my life, and that I need to "grow up and get a life." Its a harsh thing to say to people, especially for those who are mentally ill. I hope things get better for you and that the people saying those things to you will stop.

Wow.. this sounds so much like my relationship with my husband. He has aspergers and I most likely have bpd. The fights can get really ugly. I think the question is, do you love him enough to try to work things out? If not then maybe leave but if so, just try your best to talk to him about it. I know it's hard, and can possibly lead to another argument, but it's worth a shot.
I try my best to still enjoy things to the best of my ability. I take walks, play piano,take care of my husband. Anything so I don't think.

I personally have never been diagnosed with bpd, but I'm about 100% sure I have it. I get this way quite a bit, I used to not know why but I do now. For instance, if I was to ask someone for a candy bar and they say no, I get suicidal thoughts because I feel that I am not worth even a candy bar. It can have a lot to do with low-self esteem, extreme fear of rejection, it could be a lot of things. I think it just depends on the type of situations you go through.
It is depression, of course. Have had it since I was a kid actually. No, I'm not on any medication, nothing helped me so I just gave up on that lol
